name: ORKS: WARBOSS
description:
A Warboss towers above his Boyz, reigning as a belligerent general and unleashing destructive violence in battle to inspire his ladz and terrify the foe. Warbosses are the most powerful of all the Orks in their tribe, and it is they who rule the warbands. They maintain their position thanks to their size and prowess in the savage arts of war, and carry the best wargear their Meks can provide.

Might is Right

This multipart plastic kit builds a Warboss, a muscle-bound leader for your Ork armies in games of Warhammer 40,000, along with an Ammo Runt token. Brutal and kunnin' in equal measure, this huge beast aptly demonstrates that Orks get bigger as they win fights. Leading from the front, he inspires nearby troops, whipping them into a killing frenzy.

Brutality Incarnate

This kit is highly customisable. Your Warboss can be armed with a kustom choppa or power klaw in one hand, and a kustom shoota in the other, with optional upgrades to make it a kombi-rokkit or kombi-skorcha.

The kit also includes:
– 3 boss pole topper options
– 2 leg options featuring different armour details
– 1 optional attack squig
– 4 different heads, including 4 different jaw options

Contents:
– 35 plastic components
– 1 Citadel 50mm Round Base
– 1 Citadel 25mm Round Base
– 1 construction guide

These miniatures require assembly and are supplied unpainted. We recommend:
– Citadel Tools: Super Fine Detail Cutters
– Warhammer Colour Plastic Glue
– Warhammer Colour paints
